newsitem.title: ITALY: Former deputy warden of Sicily prison arrested.
newsitem.headline: Former deputy warden of Sicily prison arrested.

text.p: The former deputy warden of Palermo's notorious Ucciardone prison was arrested on Tuesday on suspicion of aiding Mafia inmates, police said.

Palermo investigating magistrates said they suspected Francesco Federico of being the Mafia's "postman", relaying messages to mobsters inside and outside central Palermo's grim jail and another prison in Sicily.

Federico, a 55-year-old pensioner, is also suspected of having allowed free Mafiosi to visit their jailed bosses for secret, nocturnal meetings and of relaying messages from jailed Mafiosi ordering their comrades outside to kill clan rivals.
Police also confiscated Federico's financial assets, including shares in a company that runs the canteen at the Ucciardone, two other prisons in Sicily and two in mainland Italy.
Most of Sicily's most infamous Mafia bosses have spent time at the Ucciardone prison, a former fortress in Palermo.
